  "sql": "WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    products.type AS "items.products.type"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON items.sku = products.sku
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  WHERE
    orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY
    products.type
), _cm_items__unit_price_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CAST(products.price / 100.0 AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "items.unit_price_sum_partition_by"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON items.sku = products.sku
  WHERE
    orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), _cm_items__unit_price_sum AS (
  SELECT
    products.type AS "items.products.type",
    CAST(SUM(CAST(products.price / 100.0 AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "items.line_sales"
  FROM items AS items
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON items.sku = products.sku
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON items.order_id = orders.id
  WHERE
    orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)

)

  _cm_items__unit_price_sum."items.line_sales" / NULLIF(_cm_items__unit_price_sum_partition_by."items.unit_price_sum_partition_by", 0) AS "items.share"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_items__unit_price_sum_partition_by
LEFT JOIN _cm_items__unit_price_sum
  ON _base."items.products.type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_items__unit_price_sum."items.products.type"
ORDER BY

LIMIT 101"

args.message: In 2025, beverages made up about 60.8% of product sales ($2,612,975) and jaffles about 39.2% ($1,683,741). Total product sales were $4,296,716. These are pre-tax figures: each item sold is counted at its product's price, and only orders placed in calendar 2025 are included.
